headline: One photo, 285 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint e5ebf2b988b6) is attached to 285 different works in 173 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 285 separate works.

This file is not a photograph of a work: it is a 73 x 73 pixel image such as a broken-image icon or a plain graphic. The portal shows this same image as the evidence photo for all 285 works, so none of them has a photo of the site in this slot.
The works are recorded as: Village Pond (219), Other (53), Bore-Well Recharge (13).
The entries were made by 7 different offices: BDPO AJNALA, BDPO Attari, BDPO Harsha Chhina, BDPO Jandiala, BDPO Majitha, BDPO Rayya, BDPO Tarsikka.
These works are spread over 7 blocks: Ajnala, Attari, Harshe Chhina, Jandiala Guru, Majitha, Rayya, Tarsikka.
